boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-additional-cost activities for currently enrolled CSUF students, including one public garden option with an optional donation.

cards.entity_name: Arboretum and Botanical Garden at Cal State Fullerton
cards.title: Take a Self-Guided Garden Stroll
cards.subtitle: Explore the 26-acre campus arboretum without a reservation
cards.notes: Meet at the entrance, follow a self-guided route through the plant collections, and check the university calendar for holiday closures.
cards.short_summary: An independent walk among worldwide plant collections, streams, ponds and visiting waterfowl.
cards.evidence_claim: The official arboretum page lists a $5 suggested donation, making payment optional, and states that the garden is open daily from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Hours and Directions - Fullerton Arboretum | CSUF
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Monday-Sunday, 9 a.m.-4 p.m., except CSUF holidays. The $5 donation is suggested rather than required; campus parking may cost money.

cards.title: Join a Group Exercise Class
cards.subtitle: Choose a scheduled workout at the Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Activate your student membership, review the current class schedule, and invite a classmate to join the same no-additional-cost session.
cards.short_summary: A rotating schedule of instructor-led fitness sessions for activated student members.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation states that group exercise classes are free to all students who have activated Student Recreation Center memberships.
cards.access_notes: Limited to currently enrolled CSUF students with an activated complimentary SRC membership; schedules and class availability vary.

cards.title: Play a Racquetball Match
cards.subtitle: Reserve one of the SRC’s two dedicated courts
cards.notes: Reserve a court up to 24 hours ahead, meet your playing partner inside the SRC, and borrow racquets through equipment checkout.
cards.short_summary: A two-person court session with complimentary loaner racquets available.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation lists two racquetball and handball courts, permits reservations 24 hours in advance and provides free equipment rental to members.
cards.access_notes: Requires an active SRC membership and Member ID. Currently enrolled CSUF students receive complimentary membership through the Campus Union Fee.

cards.title: Try the SRC Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Climb the 30-foot wall with another student
cards.notes: Bring your activated membership, check in with wall staff, and start with an option appropriate to your experience and current wall rules.
cards.short_summary: An indoor climbing session on a wall equipped for bouldering, top-rope and lead climbing.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation describes the SRC Rock Wall as a 30-foot facility for bouldering, top-rope and lead climbing, accessible to gym members.
cards.access_notes: Gym access requires an activated SRC membership. Follow posted supervision, training, waiver and equipment requirements for each climbing format.

cards.title: Meet for a Recreational Swim
cards.subtitle: Use the SRC pool’s lanes or recreational area
cards.notes: Check the current pool schedule, meet on the pool deck, and choose between lap swimming and the designated recreational swim area.
cards.short_summary: A campus swim break with dedicated lanes, open-water recreation space and pool-deck seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation lists an outdoor pool with dedicated swim lanes, a recreational swim area and pool-deck lounge chairs among SRC facilities.
cards.access_notes: Available to activated SRC members during posted pool access periods. Currently enrolled students receive complimentary membership through the Campus Union Fee.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Badminton Equipment Checkout
cards.title: Set Up a Badminton Game
cards.subtitle: Borrow racquets through SRC equipment checkout
cards.notes: Bring your Member ID, borrow the listed badminton racquets, and confirm court availability before gathering your group for a game.
cards.short_summary: A casual racket game using complimentary equipment borrowed inside the recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: The SRC equipment-checkout list includes badminton racquets and states that all listed equipment is available to members free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Requires an SRC Member ID, available equipment and usable court space. Checked-out equipment must be returned after the activity.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Basketball Equipment Checkout
cards.title: Start a Pickup Basketball Game
cards.subtitle: Check out a ball and gather players at the SRC
cards.notes: Scan your Member ID at equipment checkout, borrow a basketball, and confirm which recreation-center court is open for informal play.
cards.short_summary: An indoor pickup session supported by complimentary ball checkout for recreation-center members.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation lists basketballs among equipment offered to all Student Recreation Center members free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Requires an active SRC membership, Member ID and available court space. Currently enrolled CSUF students receive complimentary membership.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Volleyball Equipment Checkout
cards.title: Organize a Volleyball Session
cards.subtitle: Borrow a volleyball through the SRC checkout desk
cards.notes: Coordinate a small group, scan a Member ID for the listed loaner volleyball, and ask staff which court is available for play.
cards.short_summary: A group court activity using a complimentary volleyball loan from Titan Recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation includes volleyballs in its equipment-checkout inventory and says the listed equipment is free for all SRC members to borrow.
cards.access_notes: An SRC Member ID and available court are required. Borrowed equipment must be returned, and access is limited to eligible recreation-center members.

cards.title: Do a Side-by-Side Cardio Session
cards.subtitle: Use the SRC’s dedicated cardio studio with a friend
cards.notes: Meet after class, choose available machines in the dedicated studio, and set a shared session length that works for both schedules.
cards.short_summary: A flexible indoor workout in a 2,000-square-foot room with multiple cardio options.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation identifies a 2,000-square-foot Cardio Studio with multiple cardio-equipment options as an SRC facility.
cards.access_notes: Facility use requires an activated SRC membership and is subject to operating hours, equipment availability and posted safety rules.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Floor Exercise and Stretch Area
cards.title: Share a Stretch Break
cards.subtitle: Use the SRC’s dedicated floor-exercise space
cards.notes: Meet between classes, claim an available section of floor space, and follow your own gentle mobility routine without booking a paid session.
cards.short_summary: A low-key movement break in a dedicated area for stretching and floor exercise.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Recreation lists a dedicated Floor Exercise and Stretch Area for pre-workout stretching, post-workout stretching and floor exercises.
cards.access_notes: Requires an activated SRC membership. Currently enrolled CSUF students receive complimentary membership funded through the Campus Union Fee.

warnings: Eight Student Recreation Center activities require currently enrolled students to activate their complimentary membership; public and non-enrolled access may require payment.
The arboretum does not require its suggested donation, but parking on campus may require payment.
